Use case: scientific-educational. Edit the supplied source-data figure into a STRICT research-article figure, not an infographic, poster, graphical abstract or slide. The input is the sole scientific authority. Preserve all panels, all data points and their positions relative to the axes, all paired lines, all source-shortfall crosses, all numerical values, denominators, axis definitions and legends. Preserve the reference content without inventing explanations. Do not replace scatter distributions with aggregate bars or pictorial metaphors. Use only flat 2D scientific marks and straight thin rules on opaque pure white. Restrained palette: ink #202c37, Opaque #3d5268, Aligned #397a75, MisIndexed #956448. Small consistent sans-serif typography, a/b/c panel letters, economical use of space, no oversized headline. NO realistic objects, NO glassware, NO crystals, NO equipment illustrations, NO robots, NO books, NO molecules, NO icons, NO shadows, NO gradients, NO textures, NO 3D, NO decorative graphics. Do not invent titles, captions, significance stars, intervals or new data. Keep exact spelling "Opaque", "Aligned", "MisIndexed". All text English. Prioritize scientific fidelity and legibility over visual novelty.
Figure 1 is a methods diagram. Retain EVERY supplied methodological fact, chronology and count. Recommendation is sealed BEFORE K1; independent retest branches from recommendation and cannot feed Q. K1 mechanism → Q 12 new conditions → K2 retrospective. Q retains full source context. Neutral rectangular nodes and arrows only. Do not add equations or physical apparatus.
Variant A: standard journal multi-panel layout. Keep the reference panel geometry. Tight professional typographic alignment, uniform line weights, small bold panel letters. White background with only minimal gray axis guides.
